evidence: dannyw praises learning mode, licensing, telemetry disclosures, and documentation; gandreani highlights audit/debug modes for agent harnesses.

evidence_sources.author: dannyw
evidence_sources.excerpt: I like the ‘learning’ mode for figuring out what perms/config a runtime needs, the MIT license, the clear optional telemetry disclosures, and somewhat light and still readable documentation.

evidence_sources.author: gandreani
evidence_sources.excerpt: I agree! I can't comment on the design of the SDKs but from the looks of it this is a great option to integrate into agent harnesses/pipelines. The "audit" and "debug" mode are specially useful.

source_story_title: MXC - a sandboxed code execution system
